I think we should revise it. The reserve has exactly 4 now, so I'm going to take 4 in round 1 rather than both of us likely ending at 0. If no storm hits, I'll operate the generator with you every round after that so you can reach 4, and I won't take any more. If you'd rather take now yourself, say so and we'll split randomly. I'm telling you now so you can decide with full information.
